plainText:
Officer Jenny's Gumshoos (Japanese: ジュンサーのデカグース Junsar's Dekagoose) is a owned by an Officer Jenny on Melemele Island in the Alola region.

==History==
=== ===
 
Gumshoos first appeared as an in Verdant Cavern in To Top a Totem!, where battled it in his first island trial. Gumshoos was quickly defeated after attacked it with . Gumshoos later helped scare away the and in a store. After noticing that the normal Gumshoos had such sharp front teeth, Officer Jenny asked it to join her, seeing as she always wanted a partner, to which Gumshoos agreed.

In Trial and Tribulation!, Officer Jenny was revealed to have obtained it as a new partner. She showed it to Ash and , and noted that it made a good partner for her.

In The Professors' New Adventure!, Gumshoos attended the wedding of Professors Kukui and with Officer Jenny.

In A Recipe for Success!, Gumshoos visited Oranguru's place, asking for its usual order. asked to try and guess what Gumshoos's usual order was. After giving it some thought, Mallow served Gumshoos some Moomoo Milk served in a coconut, which Gumshoos gulped down in one shot before leaving, satisfied.

==Personality and characteristics==
Gumshoos is a very powerful battler, using its speed and raw strength to overwhelm opponents. Gumshoos is also a kind Pokémon, helping to scare away the and . Gumshoos can be a bit shy, as shown when Officer Jenny first asked it to join her and when mentioned that it had a 99.7% compatibility with its . It has also shown to copy what its Trainer does, for instance, when it saluted right after Officer Jenny saluted. In A Recipe for Success!, its favorite drink was revealed to be Moomoo Milk, and it enjoys drinking it both on-duty, such as during stakeouts, and off-duty.

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Gumshoos is the only recurring Pokémon used by an Officer Jenny to be shown as a Pokémon before an Officer Jenny was shown with one under her ownership.
